units.source_text: 这时候，我所以梦见究竟顶，确实因为它是自己的葬身之地。

en.t: At that moment, the reason I dreamed of the Kukkyocho was surely that it was to be the place of my own death.

units.source_text: 浓烟已经迫近，我仿佛要求救济一样，性急地叩着这扇门。

en.t: The thick smoke had already drawn near, and I beat impatiently on this door as though begging to be saved.

units.source_text: 门的另一方，只不过是三间四尺七寸见方的小屋。

en.t: On the other side of the door was nothing more than a small room three ken, four shaku, and seven sun square.

units.source_text: 而且，这时候我痛切地做了个梦，

en.t: And at that moment I had an intensely vivid dream,

units.source_text: 不过如今金箔已经基本剥落，早先小屋里理应到处都是贴满金箔的。

en.t: although by now the gold leaf had mostly peeled away, in earlier days the inside of the little room must have been covered everywhere with gold leaf.
As I knocked on the door, I was thinking:

units.source_text: 我无法说明我是多么向往这耀眼夺目的小屋啊！

en.t: I cannot describe how deeply I longed for this dazzling little room!
If only I could somehow reach this place, that would be enough.

units.source_text: 到达这金色的小屋就行了……

en.t: If only I could reach this golden little room, that alone would be enough...
